_doc: OPS-PLANS-PUBLIC-ENTERPRISE-DEPRICE-W1 CH2 — the enumeration of PUBLICLY-SERVED surfaces and
the VALUES they may not publish. Read by scripts/check-served-surface-values.mjs.
WHY THIS EXISTS. GET /api/plans/public published price_usd: 299 on the enterprise rung while
brand-facts.md:552 listed that as a HIGH-severity forbidden phrase. THREE independent controls
missed it, and each missed it differently:
· check-forbidden-phrases.mjs globs FILES. A served HTTP response is in no glob and cannot be.
· the frozen shape snapshot banned KEY NAMES only — it had no forbidden-VALUE concept at all —
and captured 299 as APPROVED.
· that snapshot's drift_check_command was a shell string in a JSON field. git grep outside
audits/ returned ZERO hits: it had never once run.
The bug class is 'the gate's corpus is files on disk, so a value published by a RUNTIME
PROJECTION is structurally invisible'. Fixing only the endpoint would leave all three blind.
ENUMERATION, NOT DETECTION. The corpus is seeded from API_CATALOG_ENDPOINTS in
src/lib/ai-crawler-allowlist.ts — the estate's own producer for .well-known/api-catalog, which
scripts/generate-wellknown.mjs renders from it. Those are precisely the endpoints deliberately
fed to LLMs. Seeding from the PRODUCER rather than the generated file keeps one derivation, and
a surface present in the producer but ABSENT here is itself a finding the gate reports.
ASSERTIONS LIVE IN THE CONTRACT, NOT HERE. A row points at its dated shape snapshot and the
gate reads forbidden_values.assertions from it. Copying them here would be a second derivation
of one contract, which is the drift the single-derivation rule exists to prevent. A row may add
`extra_assertions` for things no snapshot covers — value-regex over the stringified body, for
cases where the structure is not known in advance.
_coverage_contract: coverage declares HOW a surface can be checked, and every value other than `offline` must carry
a coverage_reason. Declared omission is permitted; UNDECLARED omission is not — the same rule
bare_token_na_reason follows in ops/forbidden-phrases.json, and for the same reason: a registry
that silently skips four of five surfaces reads exactly like one that covers them.
offline         a pure builder is importable from dist/, so the gate asserts against the
object it produces. DETERMINISTIC and needs no network — this is the
live_only       the surface is served by another runtime (Cloudflare Pages) or has no
importable builder in this repo, so only --live can reach it.
not_applicable  the surface has no JSON value contract of this shape at all (a protocol
MEASURED 2026-09-08: of the five surfaces the producer enumerates, exactly ONE has an importable
pure builder. That is a fact about the estate, not a shortfall in this gate — and stating it is
what stops the next reader assuming five surfaces are covered offline.
_verdict_contract: SERVED_SURFACE_VALUES_VERDICT=PASS|FAIL|INDETERMINATE · exit 0|1|3. Callers gate on the TOKEN, never the exit code. An empty registry, zero evaluated assertions, an unreadable contract or a dist/ that does not export a declared builder is INDETERMINATE — never PASS. Exit 0 may never encode both 'verified, clean' and 'verified nothing'.

producer.note: Enumerates ENDPOINTS. Do not confuse it with AI_CRAWLER_ALLOWLIST in the same module, which enumerates crawler USER-AGENTS — a registry seeded from that one would list bot names, not surfaces.

surfaces.note: The surface this wave exists for. Unauthenticated, listed in .well-known/api-catalog, and the machine-readable face of the pricing ladder — so a wrong figure here propagates into LLM answers about AlgoVault pricing.

surfaces.coverage_reason: The MCP streamable-HTTP transport. Its responses are protocol frames whose payload varies per tools/call, not a fixed JSON document with a value contract of this shape. Tool-description drift is already gated by tests/unit/tool-description-forward-stability.test.ts, and the response ALLOW-list by scripts/check-scan-digest-parity.mjs — this gate would duplicate neither well.

Served from algovault.com, not this Express app, and this repo exports no pure builder for it — grep for `export function build*Body` in src/ returns buildPublicPlansBody alone. Offline assertion is therefore impossible here without inventing a second derivation of a body this repo does not construct. Reachable by --live once a contract is written for it.

Same as api-performance-public: served from algovault.com with no importable builder in this repo. Its own no-data-loss invariant is already canaried by the on-chain/dashboard equality check; this gate would add value only once it carries a forbidden_values contract.

An HTML service-doc, not a JSON value surface. Its numbers are already gated by scripts/check-docs-samples-live.mjs (DOCS_SAMPLES_LIVE_VERDICT), which compares the rendered parameter tables against the live tools/list projection.
